data.description: ghostty/include/ghostty.h:1136 declares void ghostty_surface_free_text(ghostty_surface_t, ghostty_text_s*) but ghostty/src/apprt/embedded.zig:1725 exports fn ghostty_surface_free_text(ptr: *Text). Callers follow the header and pass (surface, &text); on arm64 the callee reads x0 = surface. Two consequences: (1) the text buffer allocated by readTextLocked via dumpTextLocked(global.alloc) is never freed - measured ~4.9 blocks/request, avg 21KB, ~100KB per surface.read_text in a dev build under MallocStackLogging, stack confirms heap.CAllocator.alloc under TerminalController.readTerminalTextBase64; (2) Text.deinit runs on the Surface reinterpreted as Text and may call global.alloc.free on a pointer/len read from arbitrary struct offsets - benign only while that offset is null. Affects every c11 caller: TerminalController.swift readSelectionText, GhosttyTerminalView.swift:5000 and :5241. Upstream bug in the ghostty fork (submodule 7604624d), not c11 header drift - the header ships from ghostty itself. Fix belongs in the submodule (make the export take the surface param the header promises), which per CLAUDE.md means a push to Stage-11-Agentics/ghostty plus the build-ghosttykit checksum cycle, and is shared with cmux/upstream so the operator should decide where it lands. Found while validating C11-211.
data.title: ghostty_surface_free_text ABI mismatch: header takes (surface, text), Zig export takes (text) — every terminal text read leaks its buffer

provenance.reason: Orchestrator researched root cause and wrote the plan
Plan authored by orchestrator; dispatching Codex sol delegator

data.body:
C11-212 delivered and merged.

- Change: corrected the Stage-11 Ghostty fork export to the upstream-compatible ABI `ghostty_surface_free_text(_: *Surface, ptr: *Text)`, so the actual text buffer is deinitialized; bumped the c11 submodule pointer, documented the fork patch, and accepted the generated GhosttyKit checksum.
- Ghostty fork SHA: `d4431f804d5ef1ee350898742fabc0d40e86c7ca` (pushed to Stage-11-Agentics/ghostty main before the parent pointer commit).
- PR: https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/430
- Squash merge: `703987bb42805e0baa8ade18fa6dfc61a1570c5f`
- CI: expected checksum-missing failures on run 1; run 2 at `face08225e4bf930140c412a799f49927069d947` fully green (build, build-ghosttykit, compat-tests, remote-daemon-tests, web-typecheck, workflow-guard-tests).
- Before: 50 matched full-scrollback reads retained 150 target-stack blocks / 26,278,400 bytes (3 blocks / 525,568 bytes per request).
- After: 50 matched reads retained 0 target-stack blocks / 0 bytes. Visible and 3,000th scrollback text were returned; tagged PID remained alive; unified logging showed no malloc, double-free, corruption, abort, or crash diagnostic.
- Audit: 70 matching ghostty.h/export pairs compared, 0 parameter-count mismatches. No follow-up ticket required.
- Validation deviation (explicitly ruled non-gating by the Orchestrator): selection path validated by shared free routine + read_text repetitions; mouse-selection drive not achievable headlessly. The isolated validator resolved only the tagged PID/window, sent no input, did not activate the app, and did not change the clipboard.
- Procedural deviations: an initial build accidentally inherited MallocStackLogging and was interrupted/restarted cleanly; fetches used `--no-tags` around an unrelated local nightly-tag collision; `gh pr merge --delete-branch` completed the GitHub merge but could not remove the local branch because main is checked out in another worktree, so the remote topic branch was deleted explicitly.

Artifacts: review `art_01M298PBE27NQWP8T2MT5MW7P1`; validation `art_01M29A815X4FHH07ZSG9WHA1H4`.
